event_metric_authority: Use exactly the five frozen P5.1 evaluation buckets and the frozen resolved events; no post-result custom lead/lag window.

flat_episode_definition.start: first date MARKET_STATE becomes FLAT after a non-FLAT classified date, or the initialization date if initialized FLAT
flat_episode_definition.end: last consecutive date MARKET_STATE remains FLAT before first lower MARKET_STATE; open episode uses final available date and recovered=false
flat_episode_definition.recovery_date: first subsequent classified date with MARKET_STATE below FLAT
flat_episode_definition.duration_days: inclusive calendar-row count inside the FLAT episode

event_outputs.occupancy: For each event x profile x frozen P5.1 bucket report total rows, DATA_INSUFFICIENT rows, classified rows, every MARKET_STATE count/fraction, DE_RISK_1_OR_WORSE fraction, DE_RISK_2_OR_WORSE fraction and FLAT fraction.
event_outputs.first_occurrence: For each event x profile x frozen bucket x MARKET_STATE that occurs, report first occurrence date and signed offset_days relative to frozen anchor. Do not search outside the bucket.

must_report: whether exact V1 signal parity passed
whether each profile ever recovered below MARKET_STATE FLAT after its first FLAT
first recovery date and first-FLAT duration by profile
whether all later frozen event buckets have classified MARKET_STATE rows
V1 versus V2 state differences attributable to non-absorbing MARKET_STATE

run_once.rule: Run exactly once after implementation, signal-parity and preflight gates are green. After result observation, do not change the architecture contract, V1 signal rules, profiles or evidence metrics under this study ID.
